opening.argument: The presentation explains a defined affiliate-marketing process rather than merely promising an outcome. It describes affiliate marketing as promoting other people’s products while receiving “a commission when you refer a sale,” and presents a step-by-step approach for using Instagram to build an affiliate business. The discussion of earnings is framed as a possibility, while the description expressly states, “We make no guarantees that you will make any money following the advice, tips, ideas or strategies mentioned in these videos.” Although viewers are directed to download a free guide and a tool offering free followers, reach, and views, the available evidence does not establish deception, required payment, credential collection, harmful outcomes, or a fraudulent connection.
